<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom (Init-only L1 core). Dynamic mode viability requires ModeGuard step preservation and c.K-guarded warning detection; anchored self-modification requires immutable AnchoredBase, AnchoredInit, and sound AnchoredModeAdmit/fallback gates.
- Serialized reconfiguration requires Transactions.fresh gating, reserve headroom ≥ slack, mode lag/silence/warning bounds, and non-expansive stepBoth transitions; coupled LaxSim requires SubstrateLaxSim/OpenSubLaxSim moduli with coupledBlockGain Δ + ε ≤ Δ.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Automatic synthesis of AnchoredBase, small-gain contraction Δ, or optimal dynamic mode schedules without supplied contracts and step moduli.
- Decentralized lock-free consensus under arbitrary Byzantine clocks without epoch/serial state.
- Real-valued / probabilistic Markov contraction tubes (see AlignmentReals) or value/ethical entailment beyond dynamic viability.
- **Counterexample:** DynamicPortWitness.stayBlind_crashes: remaining in .blind crashes Site 0 from 8 to 0 by step 7, whereas cycleRun cycles .blind -> .widened -> .contracted -> .widened eternally above x_crit = 3. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/PolyComposition.lean)
- **Counterexample:** SelfBlindingDichotomyWitness.unanchored_crashes: accepting .selfBlind drops PoolFromCourse registration via windowRead and crashes from 5 to 0 at step 4 from the exact same initial state kept viable by anchored_rejects_selfBlind and anchored_admits_selfWiden. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/PolyComposition.lean)
- **Counterexample:** ConcurrentSerialWitness.concurrent_serial_dichotomy: solo reqA and reqB upgrades each keep 3 ≤ x, whereas unguarded simultaneous (reqA, reqB) crashes from 4 to 0 by step 3. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/PolyComposition.lean)
- **Counterexample:** CoupledSmallGainWitness.small_gain_violation_contrast: raising drawExt to u/2 + 1 keeps solo A_bad viable at 18 ≥ 16 forever, while coupled A_bad ⊕ B_bad crashes to x₂ = 14 < 16 at step 2. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/PolyComposition.lean)
